The '''sun''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nathema]] was a [[Star/Legends|star]]<ref name="Revan" /> located in the [[Nathema system/Legends|Nathema system]], a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories's]] [[Chorlian sector/Legends|Chorlian sector]].<ref name="Atlas" /> In [[3954 BBY]], the star was a bright [[Color/Legends|orange]] color, though it appeared to be a pale brown from the surface of Nathema due to the effects of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate's]] [[Sith Emperor's ritual|Force ritual]] [[4999 BBY|over a thousand]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] earlier.<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The sun shining down on them from above&mdash;a star that had appeared bright orange as they'd approached the planet&mdash;was now a pale shade of brown. In fact, everything around them was either brown or gray, as if the colors had been leached out.|Scourge notices the star's color|<ref name="Revan" />}}
Nathema's sun was first mentioned in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', when the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] realizes another effect of the Emperor's ritual while on the surface of the planet.<ref name="Revan" /> In [[2016]],<ref name="KOTET date">{{TORweb|url=eternal-throne|text=Knights of the Eternal Throne}}</ref> an expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', titled [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']], provided the first visual depiction of the star.<ref name="KOTET">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''</ref>
